newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's BDET bank to distribute 5 pct dividend.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's BDET bank to distribute 5 pct dividend.

text.p: Banque de Developpement Economique de Tunisie on Wednesday said it will start distributing on June 16 a five percent dividend on its 1996 results.
The bank's net profits were 6.467 million dinars in 1996, up from 5.550 million dinars in 1995.
It said it has decided to allocate a total 3.55 million dinars to its reserves.
It has a capital of 50.5 million dinars and reserves were 30.862 million dinars at the end of 1996.
The state-controlled bank is specialised in loans for development projects. It is listed on the Tunis Stock Exchange. ($=1.0957 dinar)
